name: hexsketch
description: Draw and edit chemical structures in the chat, and have Claude name, check and render them.
long_description: HexSketch gives Claude a chemical structure toolkit that runs entirely on your computer: publication-quality drawings (PNG, SVG, PDF, CDXML, MOL), offline IUPAC names, formula and masses, SMILES with stereochemistry, and checks that catch mistakes in SMILES before they reach you. Every result includes a hexsketch.com link that opens the structure ready to edit by drawing. Nothing you draw or ask about leaves your computer.

tools.name: open_sketcher
tools.description: Open the HexSketch editor in the chat, to draw or edit a structure by hand and send it back

tools.name: read_sketcher
tools.description: Read what the user has drawn in the open editor

tools.name: show_in_sketcher
tools.description: Change, highlight and annotate the structure in the open editor

tools.name: render_structure
tools.description: Draw a structure as an image (PNG, SVG, PDF, CDXML or MOL), with its name, SMILES and an editing link

tools.name: analyze_structure
tools.description: Formula, exact mass, molecular weight, elemental analysis and m/z

tools.name: validate_structure
tools.description: Check a SMILES for mistakes: valence, kekulization, charges

tools.name: convert_structure
tools.description: SMILES, molfile, CDXML or a HexSketch link

tools.name: structure_link
tools.description: A link that opens the structure in HexSketch for editing
